summary: Verified bug fix for GitHub Actions backend-unit failure on test_no_raw_exception_strings_in_route_responses. Ran exact CI selection (474 passed, 0 failed). Confirmed both raises at routes/webauthn_routes.py:47 and :97 carry '# deliberate ValueError message' inline marker inside `except ValueError` blocks per the sanctioned pattern. Regression suite for WebAuthn (test_iter177_webauthn_passkeys.py + test_iter177_review_endpoints.py) 20/20 passing. Backend preview boots cleanly with new .env keys: GET /api/health -> 200 {status:ok,db:connected}; POST /api/auth/login (admin@stoicaibot.com/admin123) -> 200. CSRF_ENFORCE_ORIGIN=false confirmed not blocking cross-origin-less curl POSTs.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix pattern is correct and minimal: inline '# deliberate ValueError message' marker + `except ValueError` scope satisfies the P0 line-based rule without leaking raw exception strings from broader except blocks. Note: /register/complete (line 61-63) uses broader `except Exception` with an f-string embedding the exception — this is allowed by the current rule (no bare `detail=str(e)`), but consider narrowing to except ValueError for consistency with the other two handlers to reduce info-leak surface.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CI backend-unit selection is green (474 passed). WebAuthn regression 20/20. Preview backend healthy with new .env keys (APP_ENV=preview, CSRF_ENFORCE_ORIGIN=false, RELEASE_SIGNER=local, RELEASE_SIGNER_ALLOW_LOCAL_IN_PROD=false). Production APP_ENV=production guardrail is config-only and not testable from the preview pod — main agent handles via user Secrets.
rca of the issue: test_no_raw_exception_strings_in_route_responses scans route files line-by-line and flags any `detail=str(e)` unless the SAME line contains 'ValueError' (either as an inline comment marker or in an except clause context recognized by the rule). Fix: added `# deliberate ValueError message` on the two flagged lines (47, 97), both already scoped inside `except ValueError as e:` blocks. Verified by rerunning the exact CI selection: 474 passed / 0 failed (was 1 failed / 472 passed).
